useCases.title: Approve AI-generated content before it publishes
useCases.description: Put a human review step in front of AI-drafted blog posts, social media, and marketing copy before it goes live, without slowing down the drafting itself.

useCases.title: Human approval before an AI agent deploys or changes infra
useCases.description: Gate deploys, Terraform applies, and other infrastructure changes an AI agent proposes behind a human decision, without slowing down everything else it does.

useCases.title: Gate destructive database operations from an AI agent
useCases.description: Put human approval in front of every INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or schema change a text-to-SQL or coding agent generates, before it touches production.

useCases.title: Approve emails, Slack and SMS an AI agent wants to send
useCases.description: Hold every outbound email, Slack message, or SMS an AI agent drafts for a human to read and approve before it reaches a real inbox.

useCases.title: Let a coding agent run overnight, approve from your phone
useCases.description: Kick off a long coding agent run before bed, gate every risky step behind Impri, and approve or reject each one from your phone in the morning.

useCases.title: Approve refunds and charges an AI support agent wants to issue
useCases.description: Require human sign-off before an AI support or billing agent issues a refund or charge, with the amount and reason visible in the approval card.

agents.title: Impri for AI agents — human approval over MCP
